text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days have gone by since Agnes
Tachyon ditched the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot her in the hallway, and to avoid
being wrapped up in another
freak
experiment, I silently try to escape—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Then... you've made up your mind? You're
really going to leave?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By "leave"... Does she mean dropping out?
I suddenly stop, absorbed
in their
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I suppose. It appears that the
academy forcing me to enter the
last
tryouts was them giving me one last
chance.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You could've just...
entered the tryouts. Or
maybe... attended a few
more classes...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll always pass on wasting time that
could
go into my research. That
said, I've always
attended the useful classes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But... if you drop out,
you won't be able to
race in the Twinkle Series.
What will
happen... to your research?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll continue it,
of course. I still have my
brain and body here with me,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And it's not as if the Twinkle Series is
the
only place to race against
the best
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should move my lab overseas!
The UK, France, America,
Dubai—the
possibilities are limitless!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Overseas... That's...
pretty bold of you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha! Anything for the sake of my
research!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I plan to use this Umamusume
body of mine, of Agnes Tachyon, to
discover what lies beyond our top speed.
That hasn't
changed one bit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this? Might you be worried
about me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that after being experimented
on so many times, you've come around?!
Never fear—I'm willing to send my future
medicines to
you!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No thanks... I'm just hoping... I won't be
wrapped up in weird
experiments... ever
again.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm glad you're continuing your
research. Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Cafe, wait! I have one final
experiment... But I guess she's gone

already.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, rookie trainer. We've been
seeing each other a lot lately,
haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You nailed it. I got in because of
everyone's hopes for me, and they even
overlooked my eccentricities—but it looks
like the higher-ups
finally had enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This academy is renowned for prioritizing
its students' freedom and
does so by
providing them with cutting-edge training
facilities.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But it has no need for students who
neither
get scouted nor make
their official debut.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't need someone who skips class
and refuses scouting offers in
favor of
research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the academy recommended
that I drop out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame I won't be able to enter the
Twinkle Series. And my
research will surely
slow down as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However...
it's still better than letting my
research stagnate in favor of
school.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I knew this day would come. Perhaps I was
waiting for it. Actually, this
is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I won't have you saying something as sad
as "This is a blessing."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Now here's a surprise.
If it isn't one of
the academy's top brass.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt, but I have some
business with her. Agnes Tachyon,
do you
really intend to leave this academy?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My intentions are to continue my research,
President. Is that all you
came here to ask?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is all. As such,
I have a request
for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A request? Hmph, what could it be?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon—come for a run with me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and there you are in the stands.
Rookie trainer, you're rather
persistent,
now aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rumored Agnes Tachyon running with
the Emperor, Symboli
Rudolf? Nothing in
the world could dissuade me from
watching.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I don't hate a person who's starving
for knowledge. Watch to
your heart's
content...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Because this is the last time I'll run on
this
track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the wait,
Agnes Tachyon. It's just
us two... and this rookie
trainer. Looks like
we can enjoy our duel in peace.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that precisely why you picked this
time slot? I don't know what
you're
planning, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Now then, does 2,000 meters on turf
sound good to you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Anything is fine with me. I'm sure I'm
greatly indebted to you, so I'd
be happy
to return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is no reason to thank me—in the
end, I failed to protect you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha! You're always way too serious!
Anyways, 2,000 meters on
turf, right? I'll
go get ready.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She enrolled at Tracen to enter the
Twinkle Series for her research.
But if her
duties as a student here hinder her
research, then her leaving is inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no need for her to stick with the
Twinkle Series. She can move her base of
operations anywhere else and enter other
races with
skilled competitors.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everything she does is so logical, which
makes it all the more strange,
does it not?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why has she chosen to stay at this
academy until breaking point?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why this academy, where she can't avoid
the trainers she herself calls
nuisances?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the race between Agnes Tachyon
and Symboli Rudolf begins,
with me as its
sole spectator!
